title: Gold entity
description: A recognised entity, annotated exhaustively over a bounded chunk set — recall is unmeasurable otherwise (guide §4). Shape only.

surface.description: The text exactly as it appears. The harness checks it against the snapshot at `span`, so a tidied-up surface form fails.

type.description: The gold entity taxonomy. NOT spaCy's OntoNotes labels: `Date` here is a date that matters to examination, and `DATE` there is any temporal expression; `LegislativeProvision` here is `s 43`, and `LAW` there is the Act's title. Two vocabularies that share two spellings (Q-16).

resolves_to.description: The ref of the thing referred to, where one exists. Null where nothing is referred to, or where resolving it is the judgement the record is testing.
